name: setup-manaflow-ai-tandem-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces, after the way agent browsers and agent workspace apps are used: theme files for color, material and proportions (Tandem, light, the default; Tandem Dark), settings for a sidebar that lists every chat and tab as one line with its age and puts what waits on you first, a 14 px chat in a wide column with a compact minimap, the composer's ring on your plan's usage, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for a warm prompt bubble and roomy menus, and a customize view for a task-timeline hover card. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Tandem sidebar" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Tandem's hover card and sidebar rows: a task card (a working-for line, the title, the steps under way, the branch and pull request, what waits on you in the accent) and one-line rows with the dotted loader.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" },
    "cmux.sidebar.rows/1": { "export": "decorateRows" }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Name the rows to decorate." },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1", "onInterface:cmux.sidebar.rows/1"],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
